sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully targets frames, preserves conditional Table 4-6 applicability, applies all specified minima and units, and encodes the <=250 mm termination allowance in the verified direction.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair applicability and the termination implication. Do not use a top-level sh:or plus unconditional iceClass, hullRegion, and above-UIWL minCount constraints to require every nltl:frame to be one of the Table 4-6 IA Super/IA/IB/IC alternatives; this wrongly fails frames with other supplied ice classes and converts the table selectors into universal applicability. Encode each table row as a conditional constraint triggered by its ice-class and hull-region selectors, while requiring the applicable row's required extent/evidence. Replace the inverse termination query (permitted=true -> extension <=250 mm) with the verified allowance direction: when a frame has extensionBeyondAdjacentDeckOrTankBoundary in unit:MilliM with numeric value <=250, require iceStrengtheningTerminationAtAdjacentBoundaryPermitted true; do not make a missing or greater extension accidentally satisfy that conditional exception.

Preserve the corrected conditional applicability and <=250 mm termination direction, but add the omitted IA Super below-LIWL Table 4-6 constraints: conditionally require framingIceStrengtheningBelowLowerIceWaterline in unit:M to be at least 2.0 m for iceClassIaSuper plus midbodyRegion and at least 1.6 m for iceClassIaSuper plus sternRegion. The existing IA/IB/IC below-LIWL query must remain limited to those classes, while the IA Super bow condition continues to require reachesTankTopOrBelowFloorTop true.
Candidate faithfully targets frames, preserves conditional Table 4-6 applicability, applies all specified minima and units, and encodes the <=250 mm termination allowance in the verified direction.
